answer: An attester must stake 45% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. Because the dawn stake is held until the ember settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the zephyr audit lists each exposure. A farm running 80 keys therefore burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
